decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed two-storey side and single storey rear extension would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions.  The proposal generally complies with the intent of adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  Where it does not fully comply with policy, no harm would result.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - The extensionhereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 111 Sutton Lane.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Fridays and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - Before the extension hereby approved is first occupied, a 2 metre high close boarded fence shall be erected on the northern boundary with the footway in Sarsen Avenue from a point level the forward most wall of the side extension and shall extend to the rear of the garden.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding any details shown on the approved plans, the side extension shall not come closer to the side boundary than 0.5 metres and this dimension shall take precedence over any other stated or scaled dimension on the approved plans
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
